name: Windsurf
summary: AI-native IDE from the Codeium team with cascade agents, deep codebase context, and multi-file edits.
description: Windsurf is an AI-first code editor built by Codeium. It combines chat, autonomous agents, and inline completions with repository-wide context for faster feature work.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Windsurf IDE plans are listed on the Codeium/Windsurf site; domain may redirect during brand transitions.

features: Cascade agent for multi-step coding tasks.
Deep context across files and terminals.
Support for popular languages and Git workflows.

howToUse.title: Download Windsurf
howToUse.description: Install the desktop editor from the official Windsurf or Codeium download page.

howToUse.title: Open your repository
howToUse.description: Clone or open a folder so the agent can index the codebase.

howToUse.title: Run a Cascade task
howToUse.description: Describe a feature or bugfix and review the agent's plan before applying patches.

howToUse.title: Commit from the IDE
howToUse.description: Use built-in Git tools to stage and push accepted changes.
